trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was unhealthy across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions. Confirmed the service is now **healthy** with the error rate down to 0.2%.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the failed deploy, the rollback, and the recommendation not to redeploy v2.3.1 until root cause is found. On-call has been paged.
